def process(florida_fraud_other) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = florida_fraud_other.copy()
    df.columns = ['area', 'reports']
    df = df[df['area'].notna() & (df['area'] != 'Metropolitan Area')].copy()
    df = df[~df['area'].str.contains('Source:', na=False)].copy()
    df = df[~df['area'].str.contains('Metropolitan Areas are defined', na=False)].copy()
    df['reports'] = df['reports'].str.replace(',', '')
    df = df[df['reports'].notna()].copy()
    df['reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['reports'], errors='coerce')
    return df.dropna()

def process(metro_fraud_other) -> pd.DataFrame:
